## Argentina, Chile and Patagonia in one journey

This tour combines major cities with the natural landscapes of the south. Buenos Aires introduces you to Argentina through its historic squares, wide avenues and the neighbourhoods of La Boca, San Telmo, Recoleta and Puerto Madero. An evening tango show adds music and performance to the city sightseeing.

The journey then continues into Patagonia. In El Calafate, you take a jeep tour along Lake Argentino and visit the Perito Moreno Glacier. After crossing the Patagonian steppe, the route crosses the border into Chile and reaches Puerto Natales, the starting point for your excursion to Torres del Paine. The final stop is Santiago de Chile, with its historic centre and La Moneda square.
